svg.title: xScaler Labs Documentation
svg.desc: Observability across applications, infrastructure and AI. Documentation at docs.xscalerlabs.com.
svg.metadata: Text is outlined artwork, not embedded font software; no external fonts are required. Heading: Plus Jakarta Sans 700, 72px, -1px tracking. Supporting text: IBM Plex Sans 400 at 30px; documentation 500 at 26px; domain 500 at 22px. Outlines generated with HarfBuzz shaping and fontTools SVGPathPen; coordinates rounded to 0.001px. Plus Jakarta Sans: Copyright 2020 The Plus Jakarta Sans Project Authors (https://github.com/tokotype/PlusJakartaSans). Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/plusjakartasans/PlusJakartaSans%5Bwght%5D.ttf Source Git blob: 0cb13a998ed525ba226d911b10d6c4c4f923a961. IBM Plex Sans: Copyright © 2017 IBM Corp. with Reserved Font Name "Plex". Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/ibmplexsans/IBMPlexSans%5Bwdth%2Cwght%5D.ttf Source Git blob: 30f837e8b02e8ecddce6cbebc425b1f422392515. Both source fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Licences: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/plusjakartasans/OFL.txt and https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/ibmplexsans/OFL.txt.
